title: Mahjong nights draw young crowds to San Francisco bars, restaurants
claim: Reports Eventbrite data: US mahjong events on its platform rose 179% from 2023 to 2024.
excerpt: Search summary: Eventbrite reports a 179% increase in US mahjong events 2023->2024; SF's YLL Mahjong Club hosts parties with up to 30 tables and 200 guests; Gen Z interest in other 'grannycore' activities like needlework circles.
